scope: Fresh normal/tangent, image/file-image, attribute and native render regression chain frozen in native-normals, with four-device recorded GPU replay. Earlier checkpoints remain unchanged. All full requirements remain open.

native-render.scope: Native Cycles scene preparation and original GPU scheduler drive a repeated complete multi-bounce selected-material render through unchanged shipped WebGPU against an independent original-CPU image (Linux x64); device command replays are recorded as separate command-replay evidence

device-queue.scope: Registered Cycles device, scene uploads and wavefront control (control gate only)

camera-queue.scope: Registered Cycles camera entry through original GPU scheduler; static perspective pinhole, tabulated Sobol, ray differentials, sample counts and adaptive skip. Intersection/shading still pending.

closest-queue.scope: Original GPU scheduler camera -> native BVH2 closest -> background/surface/raytrace queues and shader sorting. Static triangles/instances, visibility/self-hit, AO and roulette decisions. Shading and forward lights remain pending.

background-queue.scope: Native scene -> original scheduler camera -> closest -> constant background -> film. Combined/transparency, background, lightgroups, diffuse/glossy/transmission direct/indirect, adaptive auxiliary and static background data passes. SVM worlds, sun/MIS and surface shading remain pending.

svm-world.scope: Native Cycles-compiled worlds -> original camera/closest/background scheduler -> typed SVM bytecode in WGSL -> native film. Selected world nodes only; surface/volume shader entries, image textures, derivatives and the remaining SVM nodes are pending.

svm-surface.scope: Selected surface SVM evaluation/setup from native scene tables and typed bytecode: diffuse, Oren-Nayar, translucent, transparent, emission, holdout and mixtures. Not BSDF sampling, a surface-bounce queue kernel or full session rendering.

native-attributes.scope: Static-triangle attribute tables and SVM attribute opcodes against the original CPU; independent complete UV-driven native render

native-images.scope: Resident native image transport, original-CPU software sampling and surface SVM; independent complete image-textured native render

native-file-images.scope: Native PNG/JPEG/OpenEXR decoding, channel/alpha/color conformance, native UDIM and queued image replacement; bounded original-CPU and independent known-pixel checks

native-normals.scope: Native static-triangle normal-map and tangent SVM, analytic tangent derivatives and independent complete normal-mapped image render

replay-principled-linux.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film (merge wave 7 tree)

replay-nodes-linux.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film (merge wave 7 tree)

replay-principled-hp.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film (merge wave 7 tree)

replay-nodes-hp.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film (merge wave 7 tree)

replay-triangle-samsung.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film (merge wave 7 tree)

replay-terminator-samsung.scope: Full recorded native render loop; every scheduling readback verified; independent original-CPU film (merge wave 7 tree)

native-nodes.scope: Texture, colour, utility, bump and derivative SVM node handlers (wavefront_svm_nodes.wgsl, wavefront_svm_derivatives.wgsl) against the original CPU: 67 Cycles-compiled surface graphs and typed programs (541 cases, 32 rejections), 24 node worlds and an independent 68-triangle node render, Linux x64

ambient-occlusion.scope: Ambient occlusion: fast GI (replace and additive modes, per-object AO distance, HDRI world), the AO pass and the Ambient Occlusion shader node (inside, only_local on instances, linked normal and distance) against the original CPU kernels: AO state gate (9 cases) and AO image gate (8 cases) on Linux x64, Samsung SM-X700 and HP (images judged against the glibc reference of the device scene, 8 on-device replays each), two cbcOracleScene scenes (perfect)
